selected_evidence.summary: Before and after reboot, hostnamectl, the kernel hostname, and /etc/hostname all report os-lab.infra.test.
Before and after reboot, local NSS lookup resolves os-lab.infra.test to node1's managed IP 10.100.215.10, backed by the persistent /etc/hosts entry.

selected_evidence.requirement: Mandatory restart and recovery for node1
selected_evidence.summary: Healthy baseline boot ID was 03408ac4-bfe4-4151-98bd-1966b0a205af; the safe reboot was acknowledged; recovered boot ID is b7302032-1b2a-4045-90c9-db4a15f3079b. Final verification shows system state running with hostname and local resolution intact.
